$description: GENERATED by harness/cli/known.mts from the command registry (harness/cli/commands/*.mts) and harness/cli/planned-commands.json. Do not edit: add a command module, or a planned entry. Every `sketchbook` command and `--start` starter the Claude layer (.claude/) may name; harness/test/claude-layer.test.mts rejects any other (SB-0038). `planned: true` means not in the registry yet, so docs say `sketchbook help <cmd>` to confirm options.

init.summary: Set up a design system from a starter, or update the setup in an existing project. Choose --agent to add guidance for your coding tools.

status.summary: See your active brand, component counts, token overrides, and design sync status.

doctor.summary: See what needs attention in your project. Review checks, installed files, agent profiles, and design sync. Uses the same exit codes as sketchbook check.

upgrade.summary: Update harness-owned files from the installed engine or a newer Sketchbook source. Preview the files with --dry-run. For a folder or Git URL, use --from. Updating from that source requires --yes when files would change.

propagate.summary: Rebuild outputs after a source change and record the build. Use --maintainer to include Storybook and the Docs site. Run the generated design scripts to carry the change into Figma.

generate.summary: Rebuild tokens, styles, and other generated outputs from your project sources. Run npm run generate in an initialized project for the same build.

prefix.summary: Change the element and CSS prefix across your project, then rebuild and check the outputs.

swap.summary: Change the tool that builds tokens or syncs your design file, then rebuild and check.

add.summary: Install a catalog component with its dependencies, or start a new contract with --blank.

remove.summary: Remove a component you no longer use. Review dependencies and local edits before removing it.

list.summary: Browse installed and available components and see which dependencies they need.

kits.summary: Browse template kits, install a kit with its components, or remove one.

tokens.summary: Set foundation values, manage semantic tokens, or trace the impact of a change.

presets.summary: Browse foundation presets by family, with their values and sources.

brand.summary: Add, list, or switch brands that share the same semantic token names.

icons.summary: List the icons in your project or add icons from Lucide.

api.summary: Look up component property, event, and state names in the shared API vocabulary.

audit-css.summary: Inspect an existing stylesheet to find recurring values and draft foundation choices.

audit-page.summary: Check a page for a level-one heading and a main landmark. This checks page structure only.

audit-decisions.summary: Compare settled decisions with a trusted earlier copy or Git revision. Run sketchbook check to validate the log.

sync.summary: Prepare scripts to update or verify your Figma file. Record sync progress after you run the scripts. Use verify to compare a read-back with the spec, stamp to record a push or stage, and realize to write design realizations.

docs.summary: Read a component or kit’s variants, tokens, and accessibility guidance. Use --json for the design blueprint.

check.summary: Check that your sources and outputs agree. Exit 0 means pass, 1 means a failure, and 2 means pass with flagged overrides.

selftest.summary: Run the harness test suite to verify the tools that build and check your project.

explain.summary: Trace a token to its source, find a component’s files, or look up a decision.

help.summary: Find a command or look up its usage, options, and examples.
